notes: Best posting windows for a US audience (owner's research, Oct 2026), in US Eastern time.
6 pm Eastern is 3 pm Pacific, so evening Eastern slots also land in the afternoon on the West Coast.
scheduledAt must carry the Eastern offset for that date: -04:00 until 1 Nov 2026, -05:00 from 1 Nov until 8 Mar 2027 (US daylight saving).
The publisher runs hourly at :17, so a post scheduled for 18:00 goes out around 18:17.
